title: Large targets and informative context necessary for semantic features
description: The paper states that a core design choice is to sample target blocks with sufficiently large scale (semantic) and use a sufficiently informative (spatially distributed) context block to guide the model towards producing semantic representations.
canonical_description: large target blocks and spatially distributed context blocks necessary for semantic representations

evidence.quote: A core design choice to guide I-JEPA towards producing semantic representations is the masking strategy; specifically, it is crucial to (a) sample target blocks with sufficiently large scale (semantic), and to (b) use a sufficiently informative (spatially distributed) context block.
